description: This PHP source file defines the SearchWrapper class in the SuiteCRM\Search namespace. It provides methods for performing and managing search operations using different search engines, including fetching engine configurations, handling external dependencies, and user preferences.

classes.name: SearchWrapper
classes.description: A class providing a unified interface for performing searches with various search engines, managing engine configurations, and user preferences.

methods.name: searchAndDisplay
methods.description: Performs a search and displays results using the specified or default search engine.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search with the specified engine and query, returning search results grouped by module.

methods.name: addEngine
methods.description: Adds a new search engine configuration to the available engines list.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available search engine class names, including custom ones.

methods.name: getDefaultEngine
methods.description: Retrieves the default search engine name from the global configuration.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns the configured search controller from the global configuration.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Returns the list of modules enabled for search.

methods.name: getModulesForDisplay
methods.description: Returns the list of enabled modules with their display labels.

methods.name: getUserSelectedModules
methods.description: Retrieves user-selected modules for search, updating user preferences.

methods.name: fetchEngine
methods.description: Validates and retrieves an instance of a specified search engine, loading external files as needed.

methods.name: getSearchConfig
methods.description: Fetches a specific configuration parameter from the global $sugar_config array.
